candidate.title: Exploring Chain of Thought (CoT) | Quick Guide from Prompt Engineering Course
candidate.description:
Ever wonder how to make AI think more like us? That's Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting! It's all about breaking big problems into bite-sized steps. This tool isn't a solo player, but a part of a super-powered combo (incl. ReAct Prompting) for cracking complex tasks. Dive into this 1-min blast from my Prompt Engineering Course.

Disclaimer: I work for AWS but this channel is my own and doesn’t represent AWS.
